items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: No, he worked with him and Willie Jackson I think.

ctx.x: Vic, I played with Vic. Who was I with when I played with Vic? I believe Manuel Key come up on the roof corner and played with a Suiv. Jimmy Johnson stayed sick for about six months. And he'd be okay, okay, come up and play with us.
What about Udel? Well he was a nice piano player. I never worked with him. Did he work with bands all along?
No, he worked with him and Willie Jackson I think. He worked together at the Cadillac County, St. Peter Rampart.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Oh, Udell, yes, indeed. Who wouldn't know Udell?

ctx.x: Oh, I was a man. You know Udell Wilson. Oh, Udell, yes, indeed. Who wouldn't know Udell? Yes, indeed. Yeah, Udell. And this other piano player, I'm trying to think of his name, he went to Chicago, never come back. New York, at least.
Do you remember Frank Ahamia? Frank Ahamia, no, I don't remember that.
